page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is an enhanced general-purpose instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, the platform features Intel Xeon 8163 processors with a nominal base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 72 dedicated vCPUs and 288.0 GB of system memory, producing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The server does not include integrated graphics processing units or local storage volumes. Storage capabilities depend entirely on remote block storage attachments. To support external volume connectivity and distributed application traffic, the instance incorporates a 33 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile. Public IPv4 addresses are not provisioned by default.

With its high core density and standard general-purpose memory ratio, ecs.g5ne.18xlarge provides substantial parallel execution capacity for scalable multi-threaded systems. The instance is suitable for high-traffic web application tiers, enterprise service hosting, extract-transform-load (ETL) processing, continuous integration environments, and distributed database nodes reliant on networked storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is an enterprise general-purpose instance within the enhanced family, designed for balanced compute and memory tasks. Based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture, it is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The instance provisions 72 dedicated vCPUs and 288.0 GB of memory, delivering a standard 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware accelerators and local storage disks are absent, requiring the deployment of external block storage for data persistence. Network performance is backed by a 33 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, providing throughput for cluster interconnects and network storage operations. Because of its large dedicated core count and balanced resource ratio, ecs.g5ne.18xlarge fits enterprise application backends, large web-serving deployments, batch data processing, and distributed database services.
